page.layout: One column of running text, with a centred heading-like number line above two short passages; no margin notes; signature at the foot left.

main_text.l: etiam cum baptizantur reclamant, respuunt,
reluctantur: accipiunt tamen & inueniunt, pul-
sant & aperitur eis, & intrant in regnum Dei,
vbi fit eis æternitatis salus & agnitio veritatis,
longè pluribus infantibus in istam gratiam nō
adoptatis ab eo qui vult omnes homines sal-
uos fieri, & in agnitionem veritatis venire. Eod. lib. cap. 8.
LXXVII.
Quando animositatem qua tenentur vice-
rint, tunc veritatem poterunt tenere qua vinc-
untur. lib.vlt.contra Iulian. cap. 13.
LXXVIII.
Dum contra regulam veritatis diabolicis
armis pugnare nituntur, nos solicitudine
respondendi faciunt cautiores: se vero decipi-
unt, antequam nostrorum valeant aliquem
vulnerare. Cum enim cæci evacuare thesau-
ros fidei concertant, spe fidei vacuati, faciunt
plenitudinem fidei Ecclesiæ, opitulante Dei
gratia gloriari: & dum in hypocrisi vigilant no-
cituri, nos quodammodo excitant dormientes,
ut arrepto clypeo veritatis, falsitati eorum cor-
de resistere vigilemus, Evangelica tuba nostris
auribus insonante, Vigilate & orate, ne intretis
in tentationem. Confidunt ergo hæretici, Ca-
tholicam fidem impugnantes, in virtute sua,
id est, in audacia cordis sui, gratia desolati,
& in abundantia divitiarum suarum, in o-
peribus scilicet voluntatis suæ gloriantes.

page.notes: The page number 147 and the running head CENTVRIA IV. are printed at the head. The long s in "animositatem" and "spe" was printed as f-like forms and is rendered as plain s. The reading "vigilant" in the line "vigilat nocituri" is printed as "vigilât" and taken as vigilant; a doubtful reading. The signature at the foot is read as "K 2" with a doubt about the numeral.
